notes.title: Playtest 1.5
notes.content:
Patch Notes - 1.5

Changes & Improvements:

    Level Clean-Up: All levels have been cleaned up for better visual quality and smoother gameplay.

    Lighting & Fog Fixes: Fixed lighting and fog issues on Level 6 and Level 8 for improved atmosphere and clarity.

    Transition Menu Removed: The transition menu has been removed (If you have a suggestion for adding one back in, let us know!).

    New Skins Cleaned Up: New character skins have been optimized for better performance and appearance.

    Blueprint & Bug Fixes: Cleaned up blueprints and resolved various bugs to improve game stability.

notes.title: Playtest 1.4
notes.content:
Patch Notes - Version 1.4

General Updates:

    Route & Track Clean-Up:

        Level 8: Cleaned up the race track route and landing pad for smoother navigation.

        Level 7: Cleaned up the route for improved flow and performance.

        Level 1: Cleaned up the route and ramp to improve gameplay experience.

    Time Adjustments:

        Adjusted times across all levels to ensure fair progression and challenge balance.

    Save Game & Data Updates:

        Cleaned up save game files to ensure data integrity and performance.

        Updated best time tracking for more accurate records and progress tracking.

New Features:

    New Skins:

        Added a brand new skin for Bronze, Silver, Gold, and Legend time achievements.

        How to Unlock: Earn the new skin by achieving Bronze on every level, and you'll unlock the corresponding skin.

notes.title: Playtest 1.3
notes.content:
Patch Notes:

    Checkpoint Time Splits Added: Players can now track their time splits at each checkpoint during the race.

    UI Updates: Various updates to the user interface for a smoother experience.

    Menu Cleanup: Tidied up and improved the layout of the main menu for easier navigation.

    Save File Fixes: Fixed issues with some save files to ensure stability and better data management.

    Ongoing Work: Transition screen improvements and saving times when choosing a level or after a race are still in progress.

notes.title: Playtest 1.2
notes.content:
Patch Notes - Version 1.2

New Updates & Changes:
Map Updates:

    Various improvements to the map layout across several levels.

    Level 8: The Landing Pad has been reworked with a fresh design to provide a more challenging and visually appealing experience.

UI Improvements:

    UI Cleanup: streamlined the user interface, cleaning up and optimizing various screens for a more polished and user-friendly experience.

    Transition Screen: The transition screen between levels has been updated with a more seamless and visually engaging animation.

    Level Select: Saves are now imported to the Level Select screen, allowing players to easily resume their progress in the level selection menu.

notes.title: Playtest 1.1
notes.content:
Playtest 1.1 Update - Patch Notes

    Best Race Times: Added a leaderboard feature to display best race times for each level in the menu.

    Landscape Adjustments: Tweaks to the landscape for improved visuals and performance.

    Level 8 Update: Updated the landing pad on Level 8 for better gameplay flow.

    Car Camera Shake: Adjusted the camera shake effect for a smoother driving experience.

    Save Game File: Made adjustments to the save game file for stability and performance.

    Car Customization Save: Updated the car customization save system for consistency and reliability.

    Main Menu: Cleaned up and optimized main menu widgets for a more streamlined interface.

Enjoy the update and continue racing!
